"# AUTOMIND AI — Project Architecture & Initialization Plan

## Executive Overview
**AUTOMIND AI** is a production-quality automotive intelligence platform combining:
- Premium animated car showcase & 3D visualization (Next.js, Three.js, React Three Fiber, Framer Motion)
- Real-time AI Car Assistant & Smart Recommendation Engine (Google Gemini API via FastAPI backend)
- Machine Learning Used-Car Price Valuation (Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, Pandas, FastAPI)
- Advanced Car Comparison & AI-assisted configuration
- High-performance database layer (PostgreSQL / Supabase)

This implementation plan focuses exclusively on Phase 1: Environment inspection, modular monorepo structure, dependency configuration, foundational design system (luxury automotive theme), and comprehensive architectural documentation.

---

## Architecture Principles
1. **Strict Separation of Concerns**:
   - `frontend/`: UI rendering, 3D viewport, animations, client state. Zero API keys exposed.
   - `backend/`: FastAPI REST endpoints, auth, Gemini AI orchestration, DB transactions, ML inference bridge.
   - `ml/`: Model training, dataset processing, feature engineering, serialization (`.joblib`/`.json`).
2. **Type Safety & Contracts**: Shared TypeScript interfaces mirroring Pydantic backend models.
3. **Design System**: Luxury/performance automotive dark aesthetic with glassmorphism, carbon/obsidian backgrounds, electric cyan & amber status accents, and fluid responsive typography.

---

## User Review Required

> [!NOTE]
> The project root will be created at `C:\Users\chauh\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\automind-ai`. It is recommended to open this directory as your active workspace in your IDE for development.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Frontend code will strictly route all AI and ML requests through the FastAPI backend (`http://localhost:8000/api/v1/...`), ensuring Google Gemini API keys and Supabase service keys are never leaked to client bundles.

---

    accident_history_count: Optional[int] = Field(0, alias="accidentHistoryCount")

        populate_by_name = True


class ValuationConfidenceInterval(BaseModel):
    low: float
    high: float
    confidence_score: float = Field(alias="confidenceScore")

    class Config:
        populate_by_name = True


class ValuationFeatureImpact(BaseModel):
    feature: str
    impact_dollar: float = Field(alias="impactDollar")
    direction: str  # "positive" | "negative"

        populate_by_name = True


class ValuationResponse(BaseModel):
    predicted_price: float = Field(alias="predictedPrice")

"from typing import Optional
import os
from supabase import create_client, Client
from app.core.config import settings

_supabase_client: Optional[Client] = None


def get_supabase_client() -> Optional[Client]:
    """
    Returns a cached Supabase client if configured
    """
    global _supabase_client
    if _supabase_client is not None:
        return _supabase_client

    if settings.SUPABASE_URL and settings.SUPABASE_KEY:
        _supabase_client = create_client(settings.SUPABASE_URL, settings.SUPABASE_KEY)
        return _supabase_client

    return None
"
